subject: My app not displayed correctly on shinyapps.io when I include a conditional panel

messages.author: bf81e85fae754b74
messages.subject: My app not displayed correctly on shinyapps.io when I include a conditional panel
parts:
I have noticed that `conditionalPanel` creates problems in shiny apps when published on shinyapps.io.
In the example attached, I have included a conditional panel displaying 'z' data only if the user selects one unique 'y' value. Locally the app works perfectly; on shinyapps.io the side panel and the table are not displayed. The problem disappears if I remove the call to `conditionalPanel`.

Thanks!
